note: The layering of scripts/ as data (issue #795). The five groups are the §Scripts groups of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; every module of scripts/ belongs to exactly one. A cross-group import is refused unless it is listed in allowed_edges with its reason, a cycle is always refused, and a listed edge that no longer exists is refused too, so this file cannot rot into fiction. Read by scripts/check_package_layers.py (`make check-package-layers`, wired into `make ci-unit`).
